instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: What should an SRS primarily specify?
questions.question_ar: ماذا ينبغي أن تحدد مواصفة SRS بصورة أساسية؟
options: Required system behavior and constraints, independent of design
Source-code classes and algorithms chosen for implementation
Daily task assignments and responsibilities across the team
Deployment steps and installation order for the finished system
options_en: Required system behavior and constraints, independent of design
Source-code classes and algorithms chosen for implementation
Daily task assignments and responsibilities across the team
Deployment steps and installation order for the finished system
options_ar: سلوك النظام وقيوده بمعزل عن التصميم الداخلي
خطوات نشر النظام المكتمل وترتيب تثبيته
questions.explanation: The SRS is a black-box statement of required behavior and constraints; design and implementation choices belong later unless imposed externally.
questions.explanation_ar: تصف SRS سلوك النظام وقيوده بوصفه صندوقاً أسود؛ أما خيارات التصميم والتنفيذ فتأتي لاحقاً ما لم تفرضها جهة خارجية.

questions.question: What does SRS stand for?
options: Structured relational database schema
Software Requirements Specification
Systematic review sequence for software
Software release schedule and milestones
options_en: Structured relational database schema
Software Requirements Specification
Systematic review sequence for software
Software release schedule and milestones
questions.explanation: SRS names the Software Requirements Specification, the document that records the agreed requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: يرمز SRS إلى مواصفة متطلبات البرمجيات، وهي الوثيقة التي تسجل المتطلبات المتفق عليها.

questions.question: Which historical IEEE standard number is cited for SRS organization?
questions.question_ar: ما رقم معيار IEEE التاريخي الذي يستشهد به لتنظيم مواصفة SRS؟
options: ISO 9001:2015 for quality management
UML 2.5.1 for software modelling notation
IEEE Std 830-1998 for SRS documentation
IEEE Std 802.11-2020 for wireless networks
options_en: ISO 9001:2015 for quality management
UML 2.5.1 for software modelling notation
IEEE Std 830-1998 for SRS documentation
IEEE Std 802.11-2020 for wireless networks
questions.explanation: IEEE 830-1998 is the historical reference for SRS organization. This tests that legacy course reference, not a claim about the current standard.
questions.explanation_ar: تسمي مادة المقرر IEEE 830-1998 لتنظيم SRS. يختبر السؤال مرجع المقرر التاريخي ولا يدعي أنه المعيار الحالي.

questions.question: A requirement says a report must load quickly. Which SRS quality is most directly missing?
questions.question_ar: ينص متطلب على أن التقرير يجب أن يُحمّل بسرعة. ما خاصية SRS المفقودة مباشرة؟
options: Modifiable through organized sections
Traceable through a recorded source identifier
Consistent with other requirements
Verifiable against a measurable criterion
options_en: Modifiable through organized sections
Traceable through a recorded source identifier
Consistent with other requirements
Verifiable against a measurable criterion
options_ar: قابلية تتبع المتطلب عبر معرّف مصدره
الاتساق مع متطلب آخر في الوثيقة
questions.explanation: Quickly has no measurable threshold, so a tester cannot determine whether it is satisfied. A response-time target would make it verifiable.
questions.explanation_ar: لا تملك كلمة بسرعة حداً قابلاً للقياس، لذلك لا يستطيع المختبر تحديد تحققها. ويجعلها هدف زمن استجابة قابلة للتحقق.

questions.question: Two SRS statements assign opposite outcomes to the same condition. Which quality is violated?
questions.question_ar: تعطي عبارتان في SRS نتيجتين متعاكستين للشرط نفسه. أي خاصية انتُهكت؟
options: Consistent meaning across SRS requirements
Traceable links to each requirement source
Modifiable statements when needs change
Independence from internal design choices
options_en: Consistent meaning across SRS requirements
Traceable links to each requirement source
Modifiable statements when needs change
Independence from internal design choices
questions.explanation: Conflicting statements violate consistency; traceability and modifiability concern different document properties.
questions.explanation_ar: تنتهك العبارات المتعارضة خاصية الاتساق؛ أما التتبع والتعديل فيتعلقان بخصائص مختلفة للوثيقة.

questions.question: A requirement defines normal operation but omits what happens when a required input is missing. Which quality is at risk?
questions.question_ar: يحدد متطلب التشغيل الطبيعي لكنه يهمل ما يحدث عند غياب مدخل لازم. أي خاصية مهددة؟
options: Non-redundant statements across the document
Complete coverage of required system behavior
Requirements ranked by their expected stability
Specified formats for external interfaces
options_en: Non-redundant statements across the document
Complete coverage of required system behavior
Requirements ranked by their expected stability
Specified formats for external interfaces
questions.explanation: Omitting an important behavior or condition leaves the specification incomplete; ranking and interface format do not fill that behavioral gap.
questions.explanation_ar: يؤدي إغفال سلوك أو حالة مهمة إلى نقص المواصفة؛ ولا يعالج ترتيب الأولوية أو صيغة الواجهة هذه الفجوة السلوكية.

questions.question: A requirement mandates a specific programming language without an external constraint. What is the concern?
questions.question_ar: يفرض متطلب لغة برمجة محددة دون قيد خارجي. ما موضع القلق؟
options: It defines boundary flows in a context DFD
It classifies requirements by audience and detail
It dictates implementation over required behavior
It links requirements to design but omits their origins
options_en: It defines boundary flows in a context DFD
It classifies requirements by audience and detail
It dictates implementation over required behavior
It links requirements to design but omits their origins
options_ar: تحديد تدفقات حدودية في مخطط السياق
فرض قيد على التنفيذ بدل تحديد السلوك
إنشاء روابط تتبع دون توثيق مصادرها
questions.explanation: An SRS should normally state required behavior and constraints without prescribing internal implementation choices unless an external mandate exists.
questions.explanation_ar: ينبغي عادة أن تحدد SRS السلوك والقيود المطلوبة دون فرض خيارات التنفيذ الداخلي ما لم يوجد إلزام خارجي.

questions.question: What does requirement traceability allow a team to do?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تتيح قابلية تتبع المتطلبات للفريق؟
options: Guarantee the economic feasibility of each estimate
Link only to design outputs while omitting requirement sources
Convert each user need to an interface encoding
Link each requirement to its origin and related work
options_en: Guarantee the economic feasibility of each estimate
Link only to design outputs while omitting requirement sources
Convert each user need to an interface encoding
Link each requirement to its origin and related work
options_ar: استبدال الحاجة إلى مراجعة وثيقة SRS
تحويل حاجة المستخدم إلى ترميز واجهة
ربط كل متطلب بمصدره وأعماله اللاحقة
questions.explanation: Traceability links requirements to their sources and related design, implementation, or verification work; it does not replace review.
questions.explanation_ar: تربط قابلية التتبع المتطلبات بمصادرها وبأعمال التصميم أو التنفيذ أو التحقق المرتبطة بها؛ ولا تستبدل المراجعة.
